taxonomic_note: Accepted by current Kew/POWO and native to Texas at state scale; current evidence emphasizes Gulf/coastal prairie and wet-alluvial settings.
look_here_first: Start with scale and habitat: small lavender-violet flowers on slender branched stems in wet alluvial or coastal-prairie settings; sharp calyx lobes and an orange-haired exserted staminode are key details.

project_inclusion.range_basis: No exact three-county project target-zone set is currently locked. Austin/San Antonio garden use and a single wild observation are not county-native proof.

approval_exception.reason: Learner inclusion is independent from native-range certification.

best_field_traits: perennial with slender erect branched stems
opposite sessile oblong to lanceolate leaves
exserted staminode with orange distal hairs
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Much smaller-flowered and wetter-site than P. cobaea, P. triflorus, or woody-based P. baccharifolius.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Small flower size plus sharp calyx, orange-haired staminode, and wet habitat.
